title: State Police Constable Entry Guide
summary: State-wise police constable recruitment process, physical requirements, and exam patterns.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction

The State Police Constable Entry offers candidates an incredible opportunity for a secure and prestigious career. It requires candidates to clear a multi-tier selection process that rigorously tests their aptitude, physical fitness, and overall capability. Thousands of aspirants apply every year, making it one of the most competitive career paths available today. Strategic preparation based on the latest examination syllabus is vital to stand out and succeed.

## Eligibility Criteria

| Parameter | Requirements |
|---|---|
| **Educational Qualification** | Must have passed 12th standard (Intermediate) from a recognized state or central board. |
| **Nationality** | Must be a citizen of India. State domicile may be required for category reservations. |
| **Stream/Subject** | Any stream is applicable. |
| **Minimum Percentage** | Only passing marks required usually. |
| **Document Verification** | Valid ID proof, educational certificates, domicile, and category certificates must be produced in original at the final stages. |
| **Additional Diplomas** | NCC / Home Guard certificates may provide bonus marks. |
| **Computer Literacy** | Basic knowledge of computer operations is often expected. |

## Age Limit & Relaxation

| Category | Base Age Limit | Age Relaxation Years |
|---|---|---|
| **General (UR)** | 18 - 22/25 Years (Varies by state) | None (0 Years) |
| **Other Backward Classes (OBC)** | 18 - 22/25 Years | Up to 3/5 Years upper age relaxation (State dependent) |
| **Scheduled Castes (SC)** | 18 - 22/25 Years | Up to 5 Years upper age relaxation |
| **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** | 18 - 22/25 Years | Up to 5 Years upper age relaxation |
| **Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)** | N/A | N/A |
| **Ex-Servicemen (ESM)** | As per standard guidelines | Typically 3 years after deduction of military service rendered |
| **Departmental Candidates** | As per standard guidelines | Up to 40/45 years of age based on years of continuous service |

## Physical Standards & Test

| Parameter | Male Standard | Female Standard |
|---|---|---|
| **Minimum Height** | 168 cm (General/OBC/SC) | 152 cm (General/OBC/SC) |
| **Chest (Unexpanded)** | Minimum 79 cm | Not Applicable |
| **Chest Expansion** | Minimum 5 cm expansion required | Not Applicable |
| **Weight** | Proportionate to height | Minimum 40 kg |
| **Running (Sprint)** | 4.8 km run in 25 minutes | 2.4 km run in 14 minutes |
| **Long Jump** | Varies by state | Varies by state |
| **High Jump** | Varies by state | Varies by state |
| **Vision / Eye Sight** | Minimum 6/6 or 6/9 without glasses, no color blindness | Minimum 6/6 or 6/9 without glasses, no color blindness |

## Written Exam Pattern

| Subject / Section | Total Questions | Maximum Marks | Duration / Time Allowed | Negative Marking |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **General Knowledge** | 38 Questions | 76 Marks | Combined with other sections | 0.50 per incorrect answer |
| **General Hindi** | 37 Questions | 74 Marks | Combined with other sections | 0.50 per incorrect answer |
| **Numerical Ability** | 38 Questions | 76 Marks | Combined with other sections | 0.50 per incorrect answer |
| **Mental Aptitude / Reasoning** | 37 Questions | 74 Marks | Combined with other sections | 0.50 per incorrect answer |
| **Overall Grand Total** | **150 Questions**| **300 Marks**| **120 Minutes** | **Applicable uniformly** |

## Preparation Strategy Overview

| Preparation Phase | Recommended Action Plan for Candidates |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Foundation Building** | Understand the complete syllabus thoroughly. Collect standard reference books, study materials, and begin clearing fundamental concepts across all subjects. |
| **Phase 2: Intensive Practice** | Solve previous year question papers. Enroll in structured mock test series. Analyze performance metrics, identify weak areas, and allocate extra time to improve them. |
| **Phase 3: Final Revision** | Create short, crisp notes for quick recall. Focus on current affairs of the last six months. Avoid picking up completely new topics just before the exam. |
| **Phase 4: Physical & Mental Health**| Maintain a balanced diet, ensure adequate sleep, and incorporate daily physical exercises to clear medical and physical efficiency tests effortlessly. |

We emphasize to all candidates that the details provided above are intended to give you a clear, structured overview of the recruitment framework. Please note that specific numbers, dates, and requirements are subject to modifications as determined by the official recruiting authority. It is highly advised to continually reference the official notification for the most accurate, binding, and up-to-date parameters. Candidates should align their preparation strategies rigorously with the official guidelines to ensure maximum compliance and readiness for all stages.
